title: Dreamscape | King Beds | Free Garage | Music Row
description:
A Spacious, Gated Free Parking Garage, Stress-Free Base for Your Nashville Stay
The home is spread across three levels. The main floor is your social hub, featuring a fully stocked kitchen with stainless appliances and a cozy living area for movie nights.

The space
Why stay here:
⬥ Real Privacy: Every bedroom has its own private en-suite bathroom.
⬥ Free Parking: Secure, private garage for 2 cars included.
⬥ Location: 10-min walk to Vanderbilt & Centennial Park; 10-min ride to Broadway.
⬥ Coffee Bar: Drip, French Press, and Keurig options ready.

Sleeping Arrangement: 
⬥ Level 2: Two Queen beds, a single fold-away, a private bathroom, and the laundry area.
⬥ Level 3: A private retreat with a King bed, a single fold-away, and its own private bathroom.

The Essentials:
⬥ Fast Wi-Fi and Smart TVs in all rooms.
⬥ Secure, keyless entry with your own unique code.
⬥ Professional cleaning and organic supplies.

PROFESSIONAL HOSTING:
Managed by a dedicated team of Property Curators focused on ensuring a 5-star stay. We provide organic cleaning supplies and 24/7 support.

Guest access
Enjoy full, private access to the entire condo, in-unit laundry, and a secured garage via a 100% contactless digital lock code.

Other things to note
⬥ To ensure a secure stay, we will send a quick digital sign-off link immediately after your booking. Simply complete this brief check-in form to automatically release your full arrival instructions and property access codes prior to your check-in date.
⬥ There is additional first-come first-serve parking in front of the building
⬥ Check-in is at or after 4:00 PM, and check-out is at or before 10:00 AM. For your security and convenience, we use a contactless keypad entry system. Your unique access code and the property address will be sent automatically 2 days prior to your arrival once your Check-in Form is signed.
⬥ Early Check-In:
We take pride in our 5-star cleaning standards. Because our professional crews need the full window to prepare the estate, early check-ins are not guaranteed and must be requested by messaging us.
